tasks.description: Extend the pure task model and persistence boundary in src/tasks.js with an archived boolean. New tasks default to false. Legacy saved tasks missing archived load as false without rewriting or erasing storage. Reject invalid archived values and the invalid combination archived=true with status other than done. Preserve archived on unrelated updates, and reject status changes that would violate the invariant. Add deterministic tests for these rules.
acceptance_criteria: New tasks have archived=false; legacy stored tasks missing the field load as active with archived=false.
Only booleans are accepted. Invalid stored values or archived=true on todo/doing tasks raise a useful error without changing saved storage.
Normal edits preserve archived, and updateTask cannot leave an archived task in todo or doing.
Tests use fixed IDs and timestamps and cover default, legacy loading, invalid values, and storage preservation.

tasks.description: Add pure archiveTask and restoreTask operations in src/tasks.js that return new arrays without mutating inputs. Only an active done task can be archived. Restoring an archived task makes it active and keeps status done plus its original ID, title, description, and creation time. Keep deleteTask as a separate explicit action. Add a pure active count helper or equivalent tested model rule so archived tasks are excluded from each status count. Add deterministic tests and persistence round trips.
acceptance_criteria: Archive rejects todo, doing, missing, and already archived tasks; restore rejects missing or active tasks.
Archive and restore preserve task history and never mutate the original array; restored tasks return to Done.
Archived tasks remain in saved local storage and survive load/save; deleteTask still requires its separate call.
Active counts exclude archived tasks in all three columns, and tests cover counts before archive, after archive, and after restore.

tasks.description: Add a separate semantic Archive view in index.html and wire src/app.js to show archived cards there while excluding them from all three active columns and their counts. Offer Archive only on active Done cards; offer Restore on archived cards. Keep Delete as a separate explicit, confirmed action. Use the pure model operations, existing save/render path, and textContent for user data. Update styles.css only if needed for the new view.
acceptance_criteria: Archived tasks disappear from To do, Doing, and Done columns, remain in local storage, and appear in a separate Archive view.
Archive control appears only on active Done tasks; Restore appears on archived tasks and returns them to Done without changing their original ID, title, description, or creation time.
Active column counts update immediately after archive/restore and exclude archived tasks; Delete remains a separate confirmed action.
No user-provided text is rendered through innerHTML. npm test and both Node syntax checks pass.
